content.short: Multichain DEX with swaps, farms, perpetuals, an IDO launchpad and price prediction games.
content.description: DyorSwap began on Mode and spread to chains such as ZetaChain, Merlin, Blast, Plasma, Stable and Unichain. Beyond swaps and liquidity pools, it bundles perpetual trading, LP farms, single-sided and liquid staking, a bridge, an IDO launchpad, NFTs and short-term price predictions in one app. Its DYOR token rewards farmers and stakers.
content.meta: DyorSwap bundles swaps, perps, farms, staking, a launchpad and prediction games in one DEX across many newer chains.
